_readme: S381 SkyRowan, 2026-10-13. Read 38433649784: Cabrillo's menu publish call links departments (2026-2027/department/<slug>, loaded through publish/content/2026-2027,department,<slug>), not programs, so the eLumen fast read found no program. This read loads one department's content call (Accounting) and its rendered view, to see whether a department page links each program's page or prints the requirements itself. Two loads, no model call.

questions.department_shape: What a department's content call holds: links to program pages (and their path), or each program's requirements inline.
questions.program_path: The address a program page uses at Cabrillo, if it has one.
